svg.title: AI infrastructure connects workload intent to hardware reality
svg.desc: An Excalidraw diagram showing workload pressures flowing through AI infrastructure placement, compilation, caching, scheduling, runtime, and data movement into compute, memory, communication, and edge hardware constraints, with a feedback loop.

g.text: AI infrastructure connects workload intent to hardware reality
The bridge is also a control loop: workload choices shape systems, and hardware constraints reshape workloads.
